review_notes: Both actual PNGs opened and visually inspected; titles, axes, legends and numeric labels readable without clipping.
Comparison chart shows four distinct variants; raw AP is not conflated with calibration-operating sensitivity/specificity.
Local original-head AP exceeds B in all five folds; operating BA is slightly lower in fold3, so not every endpoint wins every fold.
Calibration specificity target 0.90 is not guaranteed outer specificity; local outer specificity is approximately0.896.
Charts are descriptive point estimates; uncertainty must be read with bootstrap CIs in results.json and final interpretation.
